title: CampaignProposalOutput
description: Agent output for ONE marketing campaign proposal. POSTed (wrapped in { runId, proposals: [...] }) to event-planner /api/webhooks/campaign-proposal, idempotent on (runId, theme).

theme.description: The strategy theme this campaign advances (verbatim from the ingested strategy). Idempotency key with runId.

title.description: Short campaign title, e.g. 'AI-RAN momentum: own the open-vRAN economics narrative'.

rationale.description: 2-4 sentences: why now, grounded in current market signal, mapped to a Rakuten Symphony capability.

proposalContent.description: Full markdown campaign brief: market signal, target audience/companies, the angle, channels, and the supporting content to use (citing reused asset ids/URLs from the inventory).

eventId.description: Optional event UUID or slug if the campaign targets a specific event. Omit for cross-event campaigns (the default in Phase 1).

reusedAssets.description: Existing content the agent reused/repurposed (reuse-first). Cite by id and/or url from the content-inventory.

suggestedContentTasks.description: Execution items materialized as ContentTask rows on activation.

contentType.description: MUST be exactly one of the ALLOWED contentType values provided in the prompt (off-list values are dropped server-side).

tags.description: Each value MUST be one of the ALLOWED tag values provided in the prompt; off-list tags are dropped.

suggestedLinkedInArticles.description: Materialized as LinkedInDraft rows on activation ONLY when eventId is set (the draft FK requires an event).

content.description: Draft article markdown (or an outline to hand to the li-article-agent).

discoveredCompanies.description: New target companies discovered while researching this theme. The webhook resolve-or-creates these as Company records (Phase 1 enrichment).
